title: UsageSplit v1
description: Token accounting for a single model call, split into exactly five components. Unlike the artifact envelopes (which are forward-compatible and tolerate unknown fields), this object is deliberately CLOSED: the five-component split is a protocol condition, not a convenience. A collapsed or partial split hides the economics of reasoning-class models (thinking tokens are billed as output yet often reported separately) and breaks per-role cost accounting.

cache_read.description: Prompt-side tokens served from the provider prefix cache.

cache_write.description: Prompt-side tokens written into the prefix cache this call.

fresh_input.description: Prompt-side tokens neither cached nor cache-writing (fresh input).

thinking.description: Reasoning tokens reported separately by the harness. Zero when the model folds them into output; a dedicated column keeps reasoning-class economics honest.
